closure_criteria: The bound Route-A all-m proof task reaches a terminal exact result: either a rigorous all-m nonvanishing proof for the actual AP critical cofactor, or an exact counterexample with independently checkable witness.

The terminal task result preserves the exact equivalence chain from the original critical cofactor system through the transfer formulation to the factorial-Cauchy boundary/Laplacian formulation, without silent theorem weakening.
Repository-derived control state shows no unfinished task-scope work or unresolved proof obligation needed to decide the Route-A mother question.
research_value: Close the remaining all-m compression obstruction for the canonical perfectly prime-loaded table. A proof would rigorously close every sub-m polynomial cofactor repair route for this Route-A construction; an exact counterexample would identify the first genuine compression candidate.
scope: Prove or refute, for every integer m>=2, nonvanishing of the actual arithmetic-progression Route-A critical cofactor determinant associated with A_ij=product_{k=0}^{m-1}(1+i+mj+k m^2). Use the already-derived transfer, single-resolvent, supersymmetric-Schur and factorial-Cauchy Laplacian equivalences. Do not broaden the objective to general integer factoring, unrestricted arithmetic-circuit lower bounds, or stronger generic-shift conjectures unless they directly discharge the actual AP target.
success_criteria: A complete all-m proof that the actual AP Route-A critical determinant is nonzero, with every basis change, gauge factor, sign and equivalence justified exactly.
OR an exact integer m and exact zero-determinant / nontrivial-kernel witness that refutes the all-m statement.
Finite-rank experiments, numerical root locations, coefficient positivity at bounded m, or a stronger conjecture without proof do not satisfy success.
title: Route A perfect prime-loaded critical cofactor all-m closure
